name: Clock — Word grid
description: QLOCKTWO-inspired letter-grid clock. An 11×10 matrix of letters where the words for the current time light up; everything else stays dim. Pure client-side, no fetch. Rounds to the nearest 5 minutes.

cell_options.name: show_corners
cell_options.label: Show corner dots (per-minute precision)
cell_options.help: Four dots in the corners that count 1-4 minutes past the current 5-minute step, so the clock reads to ±1 minute.
